chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr and Faḍālah, from Jamīl ibn Darrāj, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a woman: is there qisas between her and a man? He said: “Yes, in injuries, until they reach one-third, they are equal. But when they reach one-third, the man rises and the woman falls lower.”
721-18 — From him, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Najrān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: the like of that.

key_terms.سَوَاءً: equal, meaning the legal treatment is the same up to the stated limit
key_terms.قِصَاصٌ: legal retaliation; equivalence in requital for injury
key_terms.ٱلثُّلُثَ: one-third, the threshold at which the ruling changes
key_terms.ٱلرَّجُلِ: the man, paired with the woman in the law of retaliation
key_terms.ٱلْجِرَاحَاتِ: wounds or injuries that are subject to legal retaliation
key_terms.ٱلْمَرْأَةِ: the woman, in the legal comparison mentioned in the ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling of qisas between a man and a woman in injury cases according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning qisas between a woman and a man in cases of injuries. It explains that they are treated equally up to one-third, and once that threshold is reached, the ruling differs between the man and the woman.
